crossRefs.note: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

translations.web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
translations.bsb: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
translations.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil
translations.asv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
